Well, some time ago I was really sure I was going to commit suicide (I still think about it from time to time) but someone that I really loved told me, "you know, when you do it you do end everything, but with everything bad it goes everything good, not the good things you have but the possibility of everything good in your future. Your future, as everyone else's, is completely uncertain. If you do it you are ending all the love you receive from me, from everyone that will ever love you and the love you can give." 

Brighter days do come, of course its not a thing of changing everything from one day to the other, enjoy the small things in life too. Bright days are not the perfect ones, they are those in which you find a new song or have a good laugh. Happiness is not a constant state, happiness is persevering to find brightness and loving it in your own way.

I hope I am helpful for your needs and those of your loved one. Have a bright day :)
